r_0143.description: Maqaayad is-kaashi ah oo bixisa cuntooyin bilaash habeenkii dadka xaalad adag ku jira. Karinta heerka sare ah oo ku salaysan cuntada dheeraadka ah ee la soo ururiyay. Waxaa maareeyay Mater Fondazione iyadoo la shaqeynayso Food for Soul.
r_0143.access_conditions: Cuntada habeenkii bilaash, hagitaan ururrada la-shaqeeyaha ah

r_0144.description: Maraq dadweyne oo bixiya cuntooyin bilaash ah duhurkii ee dadka aan khayraad lahayn. In ka badan 250 cuntooyin maalintii oo ay bixiyaan ururado khayraad kala duwan. Goobta kulanka gadaasha gaariga Cornavin.
r_0144.target_audience: Dadka aan khayraad lahayn, dadka aan guri lahayn
r_0144.access_conditions: Shuruud la'aan, furan qof kasta oo u baahan

r_0145.description: Xarunta soo-dhaweynta maalintii degdegga ah oo bixisa cuntooyin kulul bilaash ah, qubeysi, dhageysi iyo hagitaan. Soo-dhaweyn aan shuruud lahayn ee dadka la kulma keligaynta, meel-ka-saarida iyo cirib-tirida. CARE = Caritas Accueil Rencontre Échange.
r_0145.target_audience: Dadka xaalad adag ku jira, meel-ka-saarida, keligaynta
r_0145.access_conditions: Shuruud la'aan, soo-dhaweyn aan shuruud lahayn dadka waaweyn

r_0146.description: Hoyga degdegga ah oo bixiya magangalyo dadka aan guri lahayn. Quraacda iyo cuntada habeenkii bilaash. Muddada joogitaanku xaddidnayn. Suurtagal in la joogo maalintii jiilaalka. Goobta Haweenka oo gaar ah.
r_0146.target_audience: Dadka aan guri lahayn, haweenka keli ah ama carruurtooda la jooga
r_0146.access_conditions: Hoy codsiga, 10 ilaa 20 goob, muddo aan xadidnayn

r_0147.description: Hoyga habeenkii degdegga ah ee Magaalada Genève. Sariir, cuntada habeenkii, alaabta keydinta iyo gelitaanka qubeysiga oo bilaash ah. Muddo ugu badan 30 maalmood.
r_0147.access_conditions: Wac xarunta hoyga degdegga ah 0800 22 22 10 (bilaash). Muddo ugu badan 30 maalmood.

r_0148.description: Daaweynta caafimaadka bilaash ah oo sir ah ee dadka aan caymiska caafimaadka lahayn ama aan xaalad sharci lahayn. Daryeelka koowaad, la-talinta caafimaadka iyo kalkaaliyaha, hagitaanka adeegyada khaaska ah. In ka badan 4500 bukaan sanadkii.
r_0148.target_audience: Dadka aan caymiska caafimaadka lahayn, aan xaalad sharci lahayn, aan guri lahayn
r_0148.access_conditions: Laga bilaabo 16 sano, xaalad sharci shuruud la'aan, caymis la'aan la aqbalay, bilaash oo sir ah

r_0149.description: Xarunta caafimaadka bulshada LGBTIQ+ oo ku takhasustay caafimaadka galmoodka. Baaritaanka VIH/IST bilaash oo aqoon la'aan, daaweynta, tallaalka, la-talinta nafsiyaadka. Adeegga Dialogai.
r_0149.target_audience: Bulshada LGBTIQ+ iyo qof kasta oo khuseeyo caafimaadka galmoodka
r_0149.access_conditions: Baaritaanka bilaash oo aqoon la'aan ballan la'aan Isniinta iyo Khamiista

r_0150.description: Xafiiska ilkaha oo bixiya daryeelka aasaasiga qiimo aad u jaban ee dadka dakhligoodu hooseeyo. La-talinta dhakhtarka ilkaha 40 CHF, nadiifinta ilkaha 20 CHF. Dhakhaatiirta ilkaha iyo nadiifiyayaasha ilkaha waa mutadawiciin.
r_0150.target_audience: Shaqaalaha saboolka ah iyo dadka dakhligoodu hooseeyo oo aan gargaar bulsho lahayn
r_0150.access_conditions: Ballan Joogitaanada soo-dhaweynta bulshada. U gaar ah dadka dakhligoodu hooseeyo.

r_0151.description: Ururka howlgalka lagula dagaalanayo VIH, cagaarshowga iyo IST. La-talinta nafsiyaadka bilaash (fashigii 1aad), baaritaanka sirta, talada sharciga iyo bulshada ee dadka nool VIH.
r_0151.access_conditions: La-talinta nafsiyaadka koowaad bilaash. Baaritaanno sir ah.

r_0152.description: Raacitaanka bulshada iyo xirfadeed ee haweenka meel-ka-saarida ku jira. Caawinta tallaabooyinka maamulka, aqoonta xuquuqda, dib-u-hagaajinta xirfadeed. Dhageysi taleefan iyo taageero.
r_0152.target_audience: Haweenka ku jira meel-ka-saarida bulshada ama xirfadeed
r_0152.access_conditions: Bilaash, joogitaanada taleefanka saacadaha la tilmaamay

r_0153.description: Hoy haweenka ka soo badbaaday rabshadaha iyo ganacsiga aadanaha, carruur la joogo ama la'aan. Hoy degnaansho oo leh dabagal nafsi-bulsho qiyaastii 30 haween. Koorsayaasha Faransiiska iyo tababarka xirfadeed.
r_0153.target_audience: Haweenka ka soo badbaaday rabshadaha iyo ganacsiga, carruur la joogo ama la'aan

r_0154.description: Ururka is-kaashiga ee difaacaya xuquuqda shaqaalaha galmoodka. Soo-dhaweyn, dhageysi, taageero nafsi-bulsho, adeegyada sharciga, caawinta maamulka, ka hortagga IST iyo qalabka ka hortagga.
r_0154.access_conditions: Ballan la'aan saacadaha la tilmaamay. Soo-dhaweyn xukun la'aan ah.

r_0155.description: Goob bilaash ah oo macluumaad iyo talo ah oo ku saabsan hagitaanka, tababarka iyo shaqada. La-taliyayaasha diyaar u ah ballan la'aan. Casharro mawduucyo ah: qiimaynta xirfadaha, CV, wareysiga shaqada, dib-u-beddelka.
r_0155.target_audience: Dhalinyarada iyo dadka waaweyn ee raadanaya hagitaan, tababar ama shaqo
r_0155.access_conditions: Bilaash, ballan la'aan, gelitaan bilaash ah

r_0156.description: Ururka shaqo-gelinta bulsho-xirfadeed ee dhalinyarada 15 ilaa 25 sano. Shaqooyin yaryar oo ku meel gaar ah, taageero gaar ah, tababarada diyaarinta iyo raacitaanka raadinta shaqada ama tababarka.
r_0156.target_audience: Dhalinyarada 15 ilaa 25 sano ee raadanaya shaqo ama tababar

r_0157.description: Ururad madax-banaan oo difaacaya xaqa magangalyada laga soo bilaabo 1986. Caawinta sharciga bilaash ah iyo wakiilashada qaxootiga. La-talinno ballan la'aan Isniinta. Raacitaan dhammaan nidaamka magangalyada.

r_0158.description: Ururka haweenka lesbiyanka ah iyo haweennimada furan haweenka oo dhan (cis, trans, laba-dhinaceed, queer). Soo-dhaweyn, dhageysi, macluumaad iyo is-kaashi. Hawlo: filim, habeenno, shirooyin, isboort.
r_0158.target_audience: Haweenka lesbiyanka ah, laba-dhinaceedka, trans, queer
r_0158.access_conditions: Furan haweenka oo dhan shuruud la'aan

r_0159.description: Goobta soo-dhaweynta, dhageysi iyo taageerada dhalinyarada LGBTIQ+ ee dhibaatada ku jira. Raacitaan gaar ah, kooxaha taageerada, sheeko-sheeko aqoon la'aan oo online ah, hoy 3 ilaa 6 bilood laga bilaabo 18 sano.
r_0159.target_audience: Dhalinyarada LGBTIQ+ iyo dadka ku hareeraysan
r_0159.access_conditions: Ballan ama ballan la'aan, sheeko-sheeko aqoon la'aan oo online ah

r_0160.description: Ururka u adeegaya kala-duwanaanshaha galmoodka iyo jinsiga. Soo-dhaweyn, macluumaad, dhageysi iyo hagitaan dadka LGBTIQ+. Adeegga sharciga ee gaarka ah ee Suisse Romande. Kooxo: Trans*, Waaliddiinta isku-jinsiga, Bi, Tamalou (waayeelka).

r_0161.description: Ururka ka hortagga iyo raacitaanka dadka ku qaniinay khamriga iyo qoysaskooda. Talo xirfadeed, daaweynta socdaalka, kooxaha taageerada, fasaxo.

r_0162.description: Xarun maalin ah ee dadka ku qaniinay daroogada. Soo-dhaweyn, dhageysi, cunto, hawlo iyo raacitaan daryeelka. Ururka ARGOS waxay kaloo bixisaa xarumaha degnaanshada ee dib-u-gelinta.

r_0163.description: Xarunta ka hortagga oo isku keenaysa FEGPA (khamri iyo hashiish), CIPRET (tubaako) iyo RNVP (ciyaaraha/shaashiyada). Talooyiin bilaash ah oo sir ah qof kasta oo khuseeyo qaniinyada ama eheladooda.
r_0163.target_audience: Qof kasta oo khuseeyo qaniinyada, dhalinyarada iyo ehelada
r_0163.access_conditions: La-talinno bilaash ah oo sir ah, ballan

r_0164.description: Ururka waaliddiinta iyo asxaabta dadka naafada maskaxda ku jira. Macluumaad, talo, taageero qoysaska. Hawlaha madadaalada, fasaxo nasasho, safarro. Difaaca xuquuqda.
r_0164.target_audience: Dadka naafada maskaxda ku jira iyo qoysaskooda

r_0165.description: Ururka is-kaashiga ugu weyn ee dadka naafada ku jira ee Switzerland. Talo sharciyeed bilaash ah ee caymisyada bulshada (AI, APG). Hawlaha kulanka carruurta naafada ku jira.

r_0166.description: Ururka ku dhiirrigelinaya dadka waayeelka ah inay firfircoon yihiin oo madax-banaan. Hawlo kala duwan: koorsayaal, casharro, socdaalasha, shirooyin, isboort. Barnaamijka 'Seniors d'ici et d'ailleurs' ee is-dhexgalka.
r_0166.target_audience: Dadka waayeelka ah 50 sano iyo ka badan
r_0166.access_conditions: Furan dadka 50 sano iyo ka badan

r_0167.description: Wadaadnimada isugu jirta oo bixisa joogitaan, dhageysi iyo taageero magangalyo-doonayaasha iyo qaxootiga. Koorsayaasha Faransiiska, kombiyuutarka, cuntooyin wadaag, hawlaha isboortiga iyo dhaqameedka.
r_0167.access_conditions: Furan magangalyo-doonayaasha iyo qaxootiga oo dhan

r_0168.description: Soo-dhaweynta iyo raacitaanka qaxootiga LGBTIQ+. Joogitaanada sharciga oo la kaashanayo elisa-asile, taageero iyo hawlaha wacyi-gelinta.
r_0168.access_conditions: Furan qof kasta oo LGBTIQ+ ah oo qaxooti ah ama magangalyo doonaya

r_0169.description: Maktabadda ciyaarta ee degmada oo bilaash ah oo lagu ciyaaro goobta. Ciyaaraha miiska ee caadiga ah iyo kuwa iskaashiga ah oo ku kala qaybsan laba dabaq. Amaahinta ciyaaraha oo leh rukhsad sannadeed oo qoys (30 CHF). Shaqaalaha ayaa diyaar u ah talada.
r_0169.access_conditions: Ciyaarta goobta waa bilaash. Amaahinta leh rukhsad qoys sannadeed (30 CHF). Carruurta ka yar 6 sano oo ay weheliyaan qof weyn.

r_0170.description: Maktabadda ciyaarta ee degmada oo bilaash ah oo lagu ciyaaro goobta, gudaha Manège en Ville. Qiyaastii 1000 ciyaar oo miis ah, ciyaaraha fiidiyowga iyo ciyaaraha da'yar ilaa da'weyn. Amaahinta leh rukhsad qoys (30 CHF/sannad). Tartamaayo iyo dhacdooyinka la qabanayo.

r_0171.access_conditions: La xiriir khadka hoyga degdegga ee Geneva: 0800 22 22 10 (Isn-Jim 10:30-20:00, Sab-Axad 15:00-20:00). Bukin toos ah ma jiro.

r_0178.access_conditions: Ciyaar bilaash ah goobta. Amaahinta xiriirinta qoyska ee sannadlaha ah (30 CHF).

r_0179.description: Feminist and self-managed association offering a parent-baby welcome space (Marmotricité) for children aged 0-1 year and their parents. Psychomotor development support for babies in a collective and friendly setting, with special attention to families in precarious situations.
r_0179.target_audience: Parents and babies aged 0 to 1 year
r_0179.access_conditions: Free pricing, with special attention to families in precarious situations

r_0180.description: Multicultural meeting and reception place open to all. Free meals (soup, pastries, hot meals, breakfast), food bag distribution, free social support and French language courses.
r_0180.access_conditions: Free welcome, open to all, no conditions. Food bag distribution by registration only.

r_0181.description: Public utility association welcoming women in great precarity. Hot meals, coffee, hygiene services (showers, laundry, hairdressing), essential necessities, social support by social workers, listening space and monthly cultural outings.
r_0181.target_audience: Women in great precarity, homeless women, undocumented women
r_0181.access_conditions: Low-threshold reception, no conditions, no appointment. Open to any woman in a precarious situation.

r_0182.description: Historic public library with over 200 workspaces, free WiFi, free-access computer stations and reading room open in the evening. Free registration for borrowing. Access to over 30 million documents.
r_0182.access_conditions: Free entry, open to all. Free registration with ID for borrowing.

r_0183.description: Social restaurant run by the City of Geneva offering free meals (breakfast and hot meals) and first-line social support. Daytime reception with listening, social support and referral to other social partners. Free and confidential.
r_0183.access_conditions: Open year-round without registration. Free and confidential. Meal ticket from 8am.

r_0184.description: The BIS welcomes, informs and guides anyone seeking information about access to social benefits. Information and advice on financial problems, debt, housing and health. Access to social workers, psychologists and lawyers.
r_0184.target_audience: Anyone residing in Geneva, regardless of legal status
r_0184.access_conditions: Free, anonymous, no appointment needed, open to entire population regardless of legal status. Confidentiality guaranteed.

r_0185.description: Multilingual reception and advice space for parents before and after birth. Baby weighing, nursing chair, baby massage, babywearing, psychomotor development. Located in the Versoix toy library.
r_0185.target_audience: Pregnant women, parents with babies and young children, allophone families
r_0185.access_conditions: Free, no registration, open access. Closed during Geneva school holidays.

r_0186.description: Reception and support space for pregnant women and parents with baby up to 1 year. Free drop-in sessions led by midwives, psychomotor specialist on Mondays, French maternity workshop and birth preparation courses with community interpreters.
r_0186.target_audience: Pregnant women, parents with baby up to 1 year, families in migration situations
r_0186.access_conditions: Free, no registration for drop-in sessions. Registration required for French maternity workshop.

r_0187.description: Every other Wednesday, a midwife welcomes parents at the Belle-Terre toy library to discuss topics, ask questions, weigh baby and play. Snack offered by the toy library.
r_0187.target_audience: Pregnant women, parents with babies and young children
r_0187.access_conditions: Free, no registration, open access. Every other Wednesday, outside school holidays.

r_0188.description: Specialized listening, advice and support center for anti-Black racism and discrimination, managed by UPAF (Université Populaire Africaine) in collaboration with CRAN and SYNA union. Located in the AfrikaLAB space.
r_0188.target_audience: Victims of anti-Black racism and racial discrimination
r_0188.access_conditions: Free listening and advice service for victims of anti-Black racism and discrimination

r_0189.description: Association created by parents in 2007, with over 1,200 members. Support services, social skills groups, parent meetings, training, conferences, sibling groups, job coaching and Centre for Reception and Support in Autism (CASA).
r_0189.target_audience: Autistic people (with or without diagnosis), families, siblings, professionals
r_0189.access_conditions: Open to autistic people, families and professionals. Association membership available.

r_0190.description: Free public toilets located on Place du Bourg-de-Four in Geneva's Old Town. Cabins for people with reduced mobility accessible with Eurokey (available from Pro Infirmis Geneva).
r_0190.access_conditions: Free and open access. Disability cabins with Eurokey (Pro Infirmis: 058 775 31 08).

r_0191.description: Municipal library of the City of Geneva offering collections for adults and youth, a seed library, free WiFi, computer stations and cultural events. Free registration and borrowing.
r_0191.access_conditions: Free and open access. Free registration for borrowing.

r_0192.description: Reception, respite and meeting space for refugees. Support with administrative procedures, information on permits, housing and schooling, computer space and socio-cultural activities. Volunteer interpreters present daily.
r_0192.access_conditions: Open to refugees in Geneva. Free access without registration.

r_0193.description: Free, anonymous drop-in space for children aged 0-5 accompanied by a close adult. Listening and support for both child and accompanying adult. Capacity of 20 people.
r_0193.target_audience: Children aged 0-5 accompanied by a close adult (parent, grandparent, childminder)
r_0193.access_conditions: Free, anonymous, no registration. Child remains under the responsibility of the accompanying adult.
